    Stock at other Hero dealers — optional, and slow
    Everything above is our own four workshops, answered instantly. This asks Hero's Power BI for the rest of India — about 5,000 dealers. Measured 07-Aug-2026: it takes around six minutes, which is the most the server is allowed, so some attempts finish and some are cut off. If it is cut off there is nothing wrong with the login and nothing to re-authorise — just tap it again.
    Advanced: fetch with a Power BI token you paste yourself
    Only useful if you already have a Power BI session open in this browser. Paste the "Copy as fetch" of the export/xlsx request; the token inside it expires in about two hours.
